m.english: I promise you, Bella, there's nothing to be frightened of.

target.text: Te prometo, Bella, que no tienes nada que temer.

translation.text: I promise you, Bella, there's nothing to be frightened of.

m.english: Will killing an old man make you less scared of the dark?

target.text: ¿El matar a un viejo le hará temer menos a la oscuridad?

translation.text: Will killing an old man make you less scared of the dark?

m.english: He is too dumb to fear danger.

translation.text: He is too dumb to fear danger.

m.english: Those that don't fear the truth don't need to be afraid of lies either.

target.text: Quien no tiene miedo de la verdad tampoco necesita temer las mentiras.

translation.text: Those that don't fear the truth don't need to be afraid of lies either.

m.english: Fearing is dying a thousand times, it's worse than death.

target.text: Temer es morir mil veces, es peor que la muerte.

translation.text: Fearing is dying a thousand times, it's worse than death.

m.english: You have nothing to fear but fear itself.

m.target: No tienes nada que temer excepto al miedo mismo.

m.english: It is more cruel to fear death than to die.

m.english: I'm not the one you should be afraid of.

target.text: No soy yo al que deberías temer.

m.english: Spend time with him and you will see that there's nothing to be afraid of.
